title: S3 ACC Project Onboarding

steps.action: Create project from governed ACC template.
Create governed folder structure and platform services required by the project.
Apply role groups and least-privilege permissions, preserving the distinction between technical platform capability and governed decision authority.

Configure collaboration, coordination, issue, review, transmittal, naming, information-state, issue-context, and status settings required by the BEP. Configuration shall not collapse CDE information states with approval, authorization, acceptance, milestone approval, or handover acceptance decision classes.

Configure traceability from any decision-bearing workflow transition to the applicable decision type, authority basis, authorized role or party, scope/purpose, outcome, and evidence reference where required.

Review the configured environment against project information requirements, the CDE state registry, the Information Decision & Authority Taxonomy, and applicable project authority instruments before production use.
Record unresolved mappings where the platform cannot represent the governed information-state or decision semantics directly; do not substitute a misleading platform status for a governed decision.

governance_notes: Platform status labels and workflow actions are implementation mechanisms; they do not create decision authority.

Where ACC terminology cannot cleanly represent TIVERIT decision classes, the governed TIVERIT decision record remains authoritative and the platform mapping shall be documented rather than semantically overloaded.
This object does not supersede the generic W1.2 CDE setup workflow; reconciliation between generic W1.2 source logic and platform-specific onboarding remains a migration task.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-005 curator reconciliation adds explicit onboarding controls preventing CDE/platform statuses and permissions from being mistaken for approval, authorization, acceptance, milestone, handover, or reliance authority.
